subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “At first, some people worried that the fridge would become dirty or empty.”?
options: Every Saturday morning, volunteers cook soup at the community center.
Volunteers guided evening walks and explained firefly life cycles.
Every morning, a little bird came to the classroom window.
But volunteers check it every morning and evening.
